readerCopy.body: An unconventional option can become much more practical when support arrives from people or resources that were never part of the original approval system. When Jupiter sextiles Lilith, expansion and autonomy cooperate through money, education, publicity, travel, introductions, or help from the right person. The surprise can be discovering that the people who taught everyone to expect rejection were never the only people whose support mattered. The idea can grow as far as evidence and resources justify without being made smaller first.
